name: RetroArch
subtitle: Thirteen emulator cores and a 3D NES diorama mode
localizedDescription: A native visionOS build of RetroArch, the libretro emulator frontend, with thirteen cores built in (NES, SNES, N64, Game Boy / Color / Advance, DS, Virtual Boy, Genesis / Master System / Game Gear / Sega CD, PlayStation, PC Engine, Atari 2600, DOS and arcade) and a 3dSen-style 3D mode that turns NES games into dioramas floating in your room, rendered with real stereo depth. Every core runs without JIT. A Bluetooth gamepad drives the emulator; PlayStation VR2 Sense controllers can aim the NES Zapper. This app ships no games, no BIOS files and no 3D profiles: you bring your own through the Files app. Not affiliated with libretro, Geod (3dSen), Nintendo, Sega, Sony or Atari.
